what: Hovering a link or button makes the round arrow icon inside (or the element itself if there is none) swell once, 1 → 1.12 → 1x (.32s cubic-bezier(0,0,.58,1)) — on More links like ‹All articles →›, prev/next buttons, and menu row icons

options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Swelling icon (optional) — if absent, the element itself swells

from.where: On all pages: See more links, pickup prev/next buttons, mega menu, drawer, footer arrows (original linkIcon .32s)
